header.about-scanner-content:
Vulnerability scanner based on external analysis, Our tool performs intelligent site scanning, identifying risks that become visible not only to intruders, but also to search engines. This allows you to detect vulnerabilities even before they are exploited.Scanner analyzes publicly available data about your resource, such as is accessible from the outside without authorization. This includes:

Hidden administrative panels

Indexed directories and hidden files

Invulnerable entry points (XSS, SQL injection)

 Confidential data is freely available

✅ What makes our approach better than traditional scanners

 Unlike classic scanners that work only from inside the system or require access to a server, our tool:

 does not require installation on the client side

Panalizes the site like this, how an external user or bot sees it

The risks of information leakage and incorrect access settings

 Helps protect against unauthorized indexing and digital intelligence

💡🔎Why it is needed

 Our approach helps companies find risks in time that may be visible to intruders from the outside. This is important to protect your business, reputation, and customers. Such an audit allows you to:

 Understand what is visible about the company on the Internet — what data, panels and vulnerabilities are available without logging in

 Close weaknesses before someone finds them - protect yourself before indexing by search engines or malicious actions

 Strengthen cybersecurity — reduce the risk of leaks and external interference

 To meet the requirements of regulators — to help with the passage of audits and compliance with safety standards

soon-modal.title: Soon...
soon-modal.content:
🔐 New Feature: Automated Security Monitoring

Coming soon to our system — a dashboard for automated web resource monitoring.

Based on numerous client requests, we are introducing a tool that will allow you to:

📡 Launch 24/7 website monitoring

🔍 Automatically scan resources for vulnerabilities

📬 Receive real-time notifications and reports

🛡 Enhance security levels and reduce attack risks

The dashboard will be accessible through your personal account and fully integrated with the current system.

🕒 This feature is in development and will be available in upcoming updates.
